# EmeRradar

> Emeradar is a search opportunity intelligence radar and commercial signal platform that helps independent software developers validate organic search demand and SERP weakness before writing code.

## Key facts
- Website: https://emeradar.com
- Industry: Search opportunity intelligence and commercial signal platform for independent software developers
- Audience: Independent software developers, self-reliant creators and Micro-SaaS teams
- Focus market: US English search market
- Free tier: at most 1 curated pick per week
- Minimum observation period before a verdict: at least 14 days
- Prediction review points: T+30, T+60 and T+90 days

## Scope
- Products: search opportunity intelligence radar with BUILD NOW / PASS verdicts; opportunity deep-research reports (Why Now, SERP gaps, single-week MVP archetype, P0-P2 kill criteria)
- Pricing: Free $0 forever; Starter $49/month; Builder Pro $66/month billed annually ($790/year); Lifetime $1,499 one-time
- Limitations: candidates need at least 14 days of observation and do not get an instant verdict; pricing evidence cannot prove sales or revenue; no evaluated predictions have been published yet, so no hit rate can be reported
